RUNWAY
085
STUDY 108
Orange Mock-Neck & Over-the-Knee Boots
Rights check
Source: 25001.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight brown hair
walks a dark runway in a fitted orange long-sleeve
mock-neck top, a white satin mini skirt with a rounded
hem, and black over-the-knee leather boots. She
carries a small black bag by its strap. Her expression is
calm and direct. Dark stage lighting with a blurred
crowd. Palette of orange, white, and black. Bold and
sleek, in the style of a fall runway show.
Bold, sleek, runway
WORKING NOTES
- The orange top and boots create a strong color contrast.
- Keep the blurred crowd for a runway-show setting.
